scope: Remediation regressions; mocked PDF parser and browser APIs

results.name: Both PDF entry points disable evaluation/scripting, render valid input, and destroy parser resources
Oversize PDFs are rejected before reading
Non-PDF contents are rejected before parser invocation
Excess page counts and dimensions are rejected before canvas allocation
Failed import releases partial URLs, canvases, and parser resources
Total rendering and output-byte budgets are enforced with rollback
Null canvas encoding fails safely and releases resources
Cancellation destroys an active parser and concurrent imports are refused
Pre-aborted imports do not read input
Late camera permission and metadata cannot restore a stopped session
Image signature/dimension validation accepts bounded PNG and rejects oversized or spoofed images
All vendored asset hashes match the reviewed inventory
Executable entry points use local assets and CSP restricts network origins
